prompts.title: Form Rhythm
prompts.prompt:
Scene 1 — Form Rhythm (form). Canvas: 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for Fenerbahçe SK, slate #8ca6bf for SK Slavia Praha. Keep the lower quarter of every frame as a permanent subtitle safe zone: a flat charcoal band with a hairline slate rule at its top, holding yellow subtitles only. No bar, label, crest or camera move may enter that band.

EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Ritmo de forma', kinetic typography with rhythmic emphasis. The scene opens on an empty charcoal field; a single lime hairline sweeps across the middle and snaps taut. Spanish labels 'Fenerbahçe SK' (lime) and 'SK Slavia Praha' (slate) strike in from opposite edges in sync with the voice, landing with a two-frame impact and a four-frame settle, short motion-blur trails behind each letter. Between them a vertical kinetic type stack spells generic Spanish sports headings — 'FORMA RECIENTE', 'ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS' — compressing on every stressed syllable, lime blocks hitting harder while slate blocks answer a beat later. No statistical axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. At the end the two names lock side by side and a single lime pulse runs between them. transition: three-frame whip-pan into the statistical block. Exit: all type collapses onto the warm white hairline and fades.

STATISTICAL VARIANT — grouped count bars, three categories on the vertical axis labelled in Spanish: 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas'. Each category holds two bars on a shared scale with the unit 'partidos' and one common zero baseline; lime is Fenerbahçe SK, slate is SK Slavia Praha. Bars rise from the baseline over ten frames with staggered offsets and direct value labels animate as count-ups: {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. Under the plot a sample and source annotation in Spanish reads 'Muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos · Fuente: Bzzoiro'; when the two sample sizes are unequal add a warm white caret marker so the unequal samples are visible, and keep the source line attached to the sample. Camera pushes in slowly, then drifts sideways to the tallest bar. Emphasis: the lime 'Victorias' bar brightens while the others dim to a softer opacity. transition: cross-dissolve. Exit: the baseline retracts from right to left and the plot clears.

prompts.title: Goals Territory
prompts.prompt:
Scene 2 — Goals (goals). Canvas 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920; charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6 lines, lime #c5ed74 for Fenerbahçe SK, slate #8ca6bf for SK Slavia Praha. The lower quarter stays a permanent yellow subtitle band, flat charcoal with a slate hairline on top; no pitch line or bar may cross it.

EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Territorio', an illustrative football pitch and ball path. A stylised half-pitch is drawn in thin warm white lines across the upper two thirds: touchline, penalty box, six-yard box, penalty spot, centre-circle arc. A ball with a soft lime glow enters from the left third and travels a curved, clearly illustrative path across the pitch, leaving a fading lime trail; a second ball with slate glow mirrors the path from the right. The two trajectories converge but never strike a target, so nothing reads as a real scoring event. Generic Spanish headings float with the camera — 'GOLES A FAVOR', 'GOLES RECIBIDOS' — in condensed type, scaling on the stressed syllables of the narration. No axes, no counts, no invented minutes or scorelines. transition: lateral wipe following the ball direction. Exit: the pitch lines draw off screen and the ball shrinks into the subtitle rule.

STATISTICAL VARIANT — paired bars for both teams on a shared scale with the unit 'goles'. Two groups, one per direction: 'A favor' and 'Recibidos', each holding a lime bar and a slate bar on a common zero baseline. Values animate as count-ups with direct Spanish labels: {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.gf}}, {{away.ga}}. Bars grow over twelve frames; the 'A favor' pair leads, then the 'Recibidos' pair answers, giving a clear read of attack against defence without implying a forecast. A sample and source annotation sits beneath the axis in Spanish: 'Muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos · Fuente: Bzzoiro'. Camera: gentle vertical push so the taller pair enters the upper two thirds, then hold steady during the count-up. Emphasis: the tallest bar gains a lime halo while the rest dim. transition: match-cut on the ball trail. Exit: bars sink into the baseline and the numbers fade.

prompts.title: Defensive Wall
prompts.prompt:
Scene 3 — Defensive Wall (clean-sheets). 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920, charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for Fenerbahçe SK, slate #8ca6bf for SK Slavia Praha; the lower quarter is the permanent yellow subtitle band with a slate hairline, never intruded by the shield, bars or labels.

EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Muro', defensive energy and a stylised shield. A geometric shield forms in the upper half of the frame, built from stacked warm white plates that seal shut one after another like a defensive line closing ranks. The lime shield carries the Spanish label 'Fenerbahçe SK'; the slate shield carries 'SK Slavia Praha'. Each plate locks with a metallic click, a two-frame impact and a short puff of warm white particles. Behind them, concentric containment rings pulse outward on every stressed syllable, and generic Spanish headings — 'SÓLIDOS ATRÁS', 'ARCOS EN CERO' — rotate in from the sides in bold condensed type. The camera breathes with a slow push and a slight roll, then settles centre. No axes, no counts, no sample claims, no invented match events. transition: a ring pulse expands and wipes to the statistical block. Exit: the plates slide apart and dissolve.

STATISTICAL VARIANT — clean sheet counts compared directly, never converted into rates. Two horizontal bars, lime for Fenerbahçe SK and slate for SK Slavia Praha, on one shared scale with the unit 'partidos' and a common zero baseline. Count-up labels read {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}, with the Spanish category title 'Arcos en cero' above the pair. Beneath, a sample and source line in Spanish states 'Muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos · Fuente: Bzzoiro', and a small closed padlock glyph marks the annotation so the counts stay attached to their sample rather than implying a ratio. Bars extend over ten frames, staggered by four frames; a faint tick grid at every whole unit helps read the difference. Camera holds, then pushes in slightly on the longer bar. Emphasis: the leading bar reaches full strength in lime or slate while the other dims, and a thin warm white bracket measures the gap between bar ends. transition: dissolve through the shield outline. Exit: bars retract to the left and the grid fades.

prompts.title: Duel
prompts.prompt:
Scene 4 — Duel (head-to-head). 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920; charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for Fenerbahçe SK, slate #8ca6bf for SK Slavia Praha. The lower quarter is reserved for permanent yellow subtitles on flat charcoal with a slate hairline above.

EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Duelo', both teams presented as a visual duel. The frame splits along a diagonal seam; a lime field on the left carries 'Fenerbahçe SK', a slate field on the right carries 'SK Slavia Praha'. The seam crackles with warm white sparks and jitters on the rhythm of the voice. Large condensed Spanish headings clash across the seam — 'CARA A CARA', 'HISTORIAL' — meeting in the centre, pushing each other back a few units, then locking. Abstract crest-like monograms (no real logos) orbit each side and are repelled by the seam. The camera drifts laterally through the seam, then snaps to centre; a final wide hold leaves both names balanced. No axes, no counts, no score prediction, no invented match events. transition: the seam splits open into the statistical frame. Exit: the two fields slide apart and the lights fade.

STATISTICAL VARIANT — available historical win and draw counts only, on one shared scale with the unit 'partidos' and a common zero baseline. Three categories in Spanish: 'Victorias Fenerbahçe SK', 'Victorias SK Slavia Praha' and 'Empates', each a single bar; values count up as {{h2h.homeWins}}, {{h2h.awayWins}} and {{h2h.draws}}. A total strip beneath reads 'Cruces previos: {{h2h.total}}', carrying the total sample, and the source and sample annotation line reads 'Muestra: {{h2h.total}} · Fuente: Bzzoiro' so the historical record stays bound to its sample. A permanent Spanish disclaimer sits under the plot: 'Historial, no un pronóstico'. Bars grow over ten frames from the single baseline, with the total strip drawing first as a thin warm white rule. Camera pushes in modestly and holds still during the count-ups. Emphasis: the taller historical bar brightens, the other dims, and the total strip flares once when the last number lands. transition: a diagonal wipe. Exit: bars fade leaving only the disclaimer, then black.
